article.title: Out of Bounds: The NAACP's SEC football boycott misunderstands the assignment
article.author: David Harper
article.content: As long as the United States empowers a judicial and legislative apparatus that views Black political equity as an existential threat to its fabric, democracy will remain a dangerous game. Read more via Scalawag : Out of Bounds: The NAACP's SEC football boycott misunderstands the assignment .
